title: Implied-volatility state for the gotobi Tokyo-fix short: does the global risk gauge add to the approved realised-vol filter?
rationale: The gotobi short (sell USDJPY at the 09:55 JST fix on settlement days, exit 06:00 UTC, stop 0.25 x ATR20) earns the post-fix reversal of the importer USD demand that banks front-run into the fix; the approved version trades it only when ATR20 is above its 250-day median. Testable claim (narrowed at the Critic's review): global risk appetite, proxied by the CBOE VIX close published before the Tokyo open, changes the size of the front-run inventory that dealers unwind after the fix, so the post-fix reversal is larger on VIX-high days. VIX is not a forward-looking gauge of USDJPY risk in design (ATR-high and VIX-high shares diverge by year; the two trailing-year percentiles correlate 0.09 on gotobi days), which is what makes the increment identifiable and not a relabelled ATR filter. Under the 60-day goal the only gate that can raise this leg's speed is the union ATR-high or VIX-high (320 design trades, 3.8 a month, against 219 and 2.6 for the approved filter), and it helps only if the VIX-high days it adds beat the ATR-low days it leaves out; a 2 x 2 ATR x VIX table measures that, and a non-gotobi placebo separates a fix-specific effect from a VIX-conditioned Tokyo-morning drift (yen crosses bounce in the Tokyo morning after US selloffs, cycle 3). This is a measurement with a modest prior, not a likely edge: even a positive result adds a few hundredths to the basket's monthly Sharpe of 0.4.

pre_registered.kill_if: Read from every stage A cell in research.sqlite (the report keeps the top 15 rows); the GA floor and this rule apply to 'atr_or_vix' and the strata, never to 'all' or 'atr'. K1: the stratified VIX effect E = w_A x (R[atr_vix] - R[atr_vixlo]) + w_N x (R[natr_vix] - R[natr_vixlo]), weights = each ATR stratum's share of the common sample, must be at least +0.10 R in design (about one SE) with both within-stratum differences above 0. K2: the union's design t must exceed the 'atr' arm's design t (same period), and R[natr_vix] must exceed R[natr_vixlo] (otherwise the union looks faster only because ATR-low gotobi days happened to be positive in design). K3: the gotobi VIX effect (trade-weighted over the strata) must exceed the placebo effect (R[ng_vix] - R[ng_vixlo]) by at least +0.05 R; if the placebo effect is as large, the result is a VIX-conditioned Tokyo-morning drift: nothing is registered as a gotobi refinement and its sign is never used to register a standalone VIX short (a snooped flip; the US-shock-to-Tokyo family is dead). K4: before anything is adopted, from the same cells' check rows: E above 0 in check 2018-2023 and the union's check t at least the 'atr' arm's check t (the stage C gates cannot fail a gotobi subset). K5: report E gross and net of costs with month-clustered SEs; a VIX-low result is never registered as a low-vol hypothesis. Expectations: union about 3.8 trades a month (320 design trades, minimum 300); E between 0 and +0.10 R; union score 0.27-0.33 if E > 0 against 0.27 for the approved vol-gotobi; a null is recorded as 'no VIX effect larger than about 0.2 R on the gotobi', not as 'implied vol closed'; the design SE of E is about 0.10 R and VIX-high days come in about 90 episodes, so trades within an episode are not independent.

notes:
Base trade exactly as strategies/oracle/gotobi_short.py: weekdays from p['start'] (2011-01-01); SELL USDJPY at market at the first bar at or after p['entry_utc'] (00:55 UTC) within p['max_delay_min'] minutes; exit at the open of the first bar at or after p['exit_utc'] (06:00 UTC) the same day; stop = p['sl_atr'] x ATR20 (F.atr_prev(F.daily_bars(m), p['atr_n'])), no target; one position at a time; keep the oracle's guards (ei < 1, xi >= m.n, xi <= ei, ATR not finite or not positive).
Day sets: gotobi days = F.is_gotobi(dates) for every state except the placebo states, which use the non-gotobi weekdays.
States at the signal bar (ei - 1): ATR state exactly as the oracle's vol filter: med[i] = nanmedian of atr_d[i - w + 1 : i + 1] with w = p['atr_window'] (the previous 250 daily ATR20 values including the current), ATR-high = ATR20 >= med, ATR-low otherwise, undefined where med is NaN. VIX state: e = F.ext_series(m, 'vol'); sub = F.ext_subset(m, 'vol', np.isfinite(e.column('vix'))) (US-holiday rows carry a ts_avail with a null vix and must be dropped before the as-of mapping); row-wise causal percentile pct[j] = 100 x mean(x[lo:j+1] <= x[j]) with lo = max(0, j - p['vix_window'] + 1), NaN if fewer than p['vix_min_obs'] closes; mapped to bars with the ext_asof rule (last row with ts_avail <= the bar's close; the VIX close is usable from 21:30 UTC, so the 00:55 UTC entry sees the previous US session's close). V+ = pct >= p['vix_pct'] - 1e-9 (VIX at or above its trailing 250-close median, the same construction as the approved ATR median rule); V- = pct < p['vix_pct'] - 1e-9, a strict complement. Return empty Signals if the VIX subset is empty (truncated leak-test samples).
Common sample (R1): in every arm, 'all' included, a day is traded only if both states are defined; because a gotobi trade never runs into the next day, the strata partition 'all' exactly.
Arms, p['state']: 'all'; 'atr' (ATR-high, the approved vol-gotobi); 'atr_vix' (ATR-high and V+); 'atr_vixlo' (ATR-high and V-); 'natr_vix' (ATR-low and V+); 'natr_vixlo' (ATR-low and V-); 'atr_or_vix' (ATR-high or V+, the hypothesis cell); placebo on non-gotobi weekdays with the identical short, stop and exit: 'ng_vix' (V+) and 'ng_vixlo' (V-). Unknown state: raise ValueError.
Grids: spec grid (stages B and C, walk-forward, any holdout) = {state: ['atr_or_vix'], vix_pct: [50]}; stage A grid = {state: all nine arms, vix_pct: [50]} recorded as trials; the module GRID lists the nine arms so the checker exercises every value. The reference and placebo arms are never promoted. Expected design counts 2011-2017 (within a few days): all about 504, atr 219, atr_vix 83, atr_vixlo 136, natr_vix 101, natr_vixlo 182, atr_or_vix 320, ng_vix about 495, ng_vixlo about 817. Compare quantised quantities with a 1e-9 relative tolerance.
